# vastdata_rack (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vastdata_rack" "vastdb_rack_by_id" {
  id = 1
}

data "vastdata_rack" "vastdb_rack_by_guid" {
  guid = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
}

data "vastdata_rack" "vastdb_rack_by_name" {
  name = "rack-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `available_capacity` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `guid` (String)
- `is_bgp_enabled` (Boolean) Is BGP enabled for the rack
- `name` (String)
- `number_of_units` (Number)
- `row` (String)
- `total_capacity` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `cnode_ip_pool` (Set of Set of String)
- `cnode_ipmi_pool` (Set of Set of String)
- `dnode_ip_pool` (Set of Set of String)
- `dnode_ipmi_pool` (Set of Set of String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
